verify.summary: Independent verifier proved the task-owned matrix through the real HTTPS edge/application path: authentication and readiness mappings, strict manifest/crop validation, one-time zero-proposal admission with idempotent replay, exact 20,971,520-byte admission, 20,971,521-byte pre-admission rejection, no rows for rejected requests, and disposable cleanup. Focused gates also passed.

Two independent semantic focuses found no evidenced material break of the accepted realtime admission outcome, no FT-004 scope leakage, and no required operator decision. The current local edge/runtime configuration, idempotency, rejection, cleanup and SPA/revision consistency remain coherent.

TASK-045 runtime readiness was restored with real model assets, one active SPA and healthy HTTPS edge/runtime. Fresh functional verification and semantic verification both passed; the task is eligible for scheduler closure.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-006 RED: POST /api/realtime/attempts is absent; GREEN: the real edge/application boundary strictly validates manifest v1 and ordered crop_000..crop_019 JPEG parts, admits one request key once with its immutable snapshot, maps zero proposals to one explicit non-success Attempt, returns stored/in_progress idempotency results, accepts 20,971,520 total bytes and rejects 20,971,521 with 413 before any Attempt, and maps prerequisite auth/readiness failures without duplicating their owned proofs; decisive comparison: direct boundary requests inspect status/outcome and Attempt rows for valid, invalid, duplicate, zero and exact-byte fixtures; artifact: focused pytest and edge evidence under .tasks/TASK-045-T3-FT-003-W3/.
purpose: Implement the server-side realtime transport validation and idempotent core Attempt admission boundary independently of browser request construction.
success_outcome: The public endpoint admits exactly one valid bounded request, persists its immutable core Attempt, handles zero proposals and exact transport failures, and invokes no FT-004 search behavior.
anti_goals: Do not form browser multipart requests or collect client monotonic markers.
Do not implement authentication internals, context persistence/resolution, slot/search/result/session behavior or a custom error framework.
Do not add extra payload caps, client truncation, waiter queues or replay.

forbidden_scope: Authentication and immutable context internals owned by TASK-057-T3-FT-003-W2 and TASK-060-T2-FT-003-W2
Client request formation owned by TASK-052-T2-FT-003-W4
FT-004 singleton slot, deadline, search and result/session behavior
stop_conditions: Admission cannot avoid moving FT-004 search behavior into this task.
The public edge cannot enforce the exact total-body boundary before domain admission.
Idempotency requires a waiter queue, durable replay or distributed lock.

constraints: Enforce 20,971,520 bytes at both Caddy and realtime application boundaries on the exact public path.
Persist the immutable snapshot before inference; in the FT-003 window nonzero proposals may end at the accepted technical internal_failure seam.
Use task-owned disposable clients/settings/Attempts and clean them up without changing operator/default state.
invariants: Transport/validation rejection creates no core Attempt or domain outcome.
The body never overrides token-derived spa_id and contains no credential.
The endpoint consumes authentication and readiness boundaries without re-owning their claims.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-006 direct requests prove exact validation, idempotency, zero-proposal admission and byte boundary.
Integration delta proves prerequisite 401/429/503 mappings and the public HTTPS route without duplicating auth/readiness ownership.
